result:
Regression fixed. `anthrouter/http_util.py` read the header `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`, but the real header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`. The requests count was never recorded, so the DB row and status showed `None`. I corrected the header name.

I re-ran only the rate-limit tests (8 passed, including the two that failed). I didn't re-run the full suite.
